title: Toward lower-cost carbon capture, utilization, and storage: Fit-for-purpose CO2 conditioning and source–sink coordination
summary: Paper in Petroleum Science by Hai-Zhu Wang and co-authors. As its title states, it addresses lowering CCUS costs through fit-for-purpose CO2 conditioning and source–sink coordination.
why_it_matters: Source–sink matching and CO2 quality specifications are core inputs to CCS network design and cost optimisation.
